correctness.rationale: Exact depth-h characteristic signatures yield a bijection with root colors and subsets of earlier signatures. Distinct required successor types force distinct children, proving a sharp additive tree-size lower bound and the unique recursive attaining tree. Complementation proves palindromic counts and mean, a complete-subset-sum induction proves gap-free support; direct independent Bernoulli representation proves moment recurrences. The Berry--Esseen and Hoeffding inequalities are applied with explicitly computed moments and checked constants. Independent small-tree enumeration, direct back/forth tests, and complete polynomial histograms pass via the actual bundled checker. Finite tests supplement but are not used as infinite proof.

residual_risks: Older hereditarily finite-set weight enumerations, unindexed tree-automata work or modal model-size distribution papers may contain equivalent formulas under different terminology; no completeness guarantee from finite searches.

value.rationale: The entire order spectrum and coefficients across all bounded modal types directly quantify how costly tree unravelling witnesses are, rather than arbitrary graph optimizations or one-off finite tables. Unique minimizers, all feasible sizes, sharp endpoint multiplicities, and a precise typical-size normal law give a natural complete classification and concentration theorem. The all-depth exact distribution is not implied by merely knowing the usual unweighted type counts; no claim is made that child-set normal forms or normal inequalities alone are new.
